wikiTaskPage: Revenants (no 'Slayer task/Revenants' page exists; monster page used, plus Krystilia and Revenant Caves pages)
summary: A Krystilia-only Wilderness task done in the Revenant Caves, usually with Ranged (Craw's or Webweaver bow) while wearing a charged bracelet of ethereum, which cuts revenant damage by 75% and removes their aggression. Pray Protect from Magic and Protect Item, since magic is their most accurate style. Revenants are undead, so a salve amulet or amulet of avarice boosts damage, and Wilderness weapon drop rates are 5x while on a Krystilia task.
styleNotes: Undead (salve amulet and amulet of avarice work); they use all three combat styles and adapt to your prayers and defensive bonuses; they heal below 50% health; a charged bracelet of ethereum is effectively required.
usefulItems: Amulet of avarice or Salve amulet(ei)
Revenant cave teleport or Burning amulet
Royal seed pod (one-click escape at level 30 or below)

locations.name: Revenant Caves
locations.displayName: Revenant Caves (Wilderness 17-40, singles-plus, 100k entry fee)
requirements: 100,000 coin entry fee (repaid only if you die)
locations.notes: Three one-way entrances: level 17 (east of Dark Warriors' Fortress), level 26 (north of Bandit Camp) and level 40 (south-east of Lava Maze); Revenant cave teleport goes to the level 40 entrance. Singles-plus: another player can attack you while you fight a revenant. Agility shortcuts at 65/75/89. The Revenants page itself gives the revenants' range as 'levels 19 to 40' and Krystilia's table lists 19-38; the 17-40 range is the whole cave (Revenant Caves page).

evidence.multi: 'it is an extremely dangerous cave that ranges from level 17 to 40 Wilderness and is exclusively a singles-plus combat area.' (Revenant Caves). Singles-plus means only one monster fights you but PvP overrides PvM; recorded as false (not multi) with this caveat.
evidence.cannon: 'A dwarf multicannon cannot be placed in the caves.' (Revenant Caves); also listed under Revenant Caves in the Dwarf multicannon prohibited list.
evidence.requirements: 'Before entering the caves, players must pay a fee of 100,000 coins. The fee can be taken from the bank ... Upon dying to anything inside the caves (including monsters) or to another player anywhere in the Wilderness, the fee will be lost' (Revenant Caves).

notes: Assigned only by Krystilia (Slayer task list row: Krystilia; Krystilia table: 40-100 assigned, 100-150 extended). Slayer XP varies by revenant (Krystilia table lists 10-140 per kill), so xpPerKill is null. 'The drop rates for the Wilderness weapons are increased by 5 times the normal rate when assigned a revenants Slayer task from Krystilia' (Revenants). 'several revenants cannot be killed for a task (e.g. the revenant pyrefiend cannot be killed in place of normal pyrefiends)' (Revenants, Trivia). Player killers are common in the caves (Revenants).

corrections: summary: removed the player-killer warning sentence (summaries must not warn about other players); moved the PK note to task notes

wikiTaskPage: Rogue (no 'Slayer task/Rogues' page exists; monster page used, plus Rogues' Castle and Krystilia pages)
summary: A Krystilia-only task completed at the Rogues' Castle in level 52-56 Wilderness, where the level 15 rogues are killed quickly with any style; the level 135 rogues also count but are much tougher. Rogues are not aggressive unless you loot the castle chests. The Chaos Elemental lurks around and inside the castle and can bind and unequip players, so bring only what you can afford to lose.
styleNotes: Level 15 rogues have 17 hitpoints and negligible defence; not immune to cannon or thralls; no poison immunity noted.
usefulItems: Wilderness Obelisk or Ardougne/Edgeville lever for travel

summary: Nieve-only task done in the Sophanem Dungeon, where locust riders (ranged/melee) and scarab mages (magic) sit near the entrance of the maze level, or in the multicombat cavern level for a cannon and melee. Pray Protect from Missiles against locust riders or Protect from Magic against scarab mages; Guthan's makes the task sustainable, and a keris or keris partisan hits scabarites harder. Bring a light source and a tinderbox, watch for floor traps and trapdoors, and carry an emergency teleport because the cavern level uses all three styles at once. Low-level players can instead kill small scarabs in the Uzer Mastaba.
styleNotes: All scabarites are susceptible to the keris and keris partisan; locust riders and scarab mages have no poison immunity and are not immune to cannon or thralls (infoboxes).
requiredItems: Light source (e.g. Kandarin headgear or lantern)

summary: A Vannaka/Chaeldar task after Legends' Quest, done in the dungeon beneath the Legends' Guild where 19 aggressive level 48 shadow warriors spawn. wikiTaskPage: Slayer task/Skeletal Wyvern (fetches the same content as Skeletal Wyvern/Strategies)
summary: A 72 Slayer task from Chaeldar, Konar, Nieve and Duradel done at the end of the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, where an elemental, mind, dragonfire or ancient wyvern shield cuts their icy breath from 50+ to 10. They are draconic, so a dragon hunter lance (pound/swipe) or dragon hunter crossbow is best; pray Protect from Melee in melee range or Protect from Missiles otherwise, and a cannon is allowed in the lower cave. Many players safespot them with a crossbow after they lose aggression, using the cave door or a tile north-west of Steve; a task-only upper area exists but is a no-cannon zone.
styleNotes: Draconic (dragonbane weapons and enchanted dragonstone bolts work) but NOT undead (salve amulet does nothing); high stab defence so use the lance's pound/swipe styles; regenerate 1 HP per 10 ticks; not immune to cannon or thralls; elemental weakness Fire 25%.
requiredItems: Elemental shield, Mind shield, Dragonfire shield, Dragonfire ward or Ancient wyvern shield
usefulItems: Dragon hunter crossbow with diamond dragon bolts (e)

summary: A beginner task from Turael, Spria and Mazchna (or Krystilia in the Wilderness) against undead skeletons, best killed with a crush weapon and a salve amulet because of their low crush defence, or with earth spells which exploit their elemental weakness.
